title: ENIGMA R.D.E. machine one: next ten-piece black PLA day plate
material: PLA Basic · right 0.4 mm · supports off

source.evidence: Clean pushed current main, complete open-PR check, feedback/inventory check, normal online print gate and retained-mesh/profile/toolpath audit passed. Source geometry unchanged; no physical acceptance. Current printer FTPS rejected upload553 and the target was absent; these new files are staged on both Macs but not transferred or started. Re-prepared through the normal online gate and retained-mesh audit on clean pushed current main8d64872c after the schedule-only update. Exact slice bytes, meshes, process and quantities are unchanged.

notes: Next after the red mechanical trial and morning bed clearing, targeted 08:00-08:10 Oslo on 18 November. Slicer estimate: 8 h 18 m 22 s, giving 16:18-16:28 finish; allow startup, cooldown and cleanup before Joachim at 17:00. One specimen per selected role. Black PLA Basic A3; right 0.4 mm nozzle; 0.15 mm layers (0.20 first), 3 walls, 15% infill, 5 mm brims and 220 C / 55 C textured PEI. Supports off; grinder-cap bridge angle 90 retained. Both previews show actual first-layer GCode, with grey removable brims; no native slicer PNG was produced. Re-prepared and audited on current main 8d64872c; slice bytes and process are unchanged. Earlier upload error 553 delayed the unstarted evening proposal; storage later recovered. This day plate is uploaded; its downloaded copy passed byte-identical SHA-256 comparison. Fresh source, bed and material checks remain mandatory before its own start. No second job start or physical qualification is claimed. Geometry: HdM Project ENIGMA R.D.E., Prof. Dr. Simon Wiest, revision 397ca89, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
previewCaption: Actual first-layer GCode for this exact slice; grey is removable brim, purple is removable same-PLA support. No native slicer bitmap was produced.
layoutCaption: The same exact first-layer GCode plot viewed from above; a separate native layout bitmap is unavailable.
